subject: Greenscreen tech & panel rotation plan — finalizing speaker slots
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenscreen tech & panel rotation plan — finalizing speaker slots

Hey team,

Rough draft of the greenscreen panel rotation attached (run_order_v2.pdf). Key asks before I loop in Priya and the CloudScale events team:
- Confirm final speaker order and who will standby as backup for each slot.
- AV constraints: Marissa, can you confirm whether we can do 2 consecutive greenscreen handoffs without a hard reset? If not, we need to insert a 2-minute buffer.
- Lauren, can you confirm the moderator cue timings (30s intro, 12 min talk, 8 min q/a) fit with the sponsor outro?

I pushed a staging copy to Drive here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cRUNORDER — please leave comments rather than editing.

Attachments: [Attachment: run_order_v2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:39:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenscreen tech & panel rotation plan — finalizing speaker slots

Ben —

Looks good overall. Quick AV notes from rehearsal room:
- Greenscreen hardware needs a 90s swap window between talent to prevent light spill; insert 2-minute buffer between turns.
- We can hot-swap mics but the cleanest path is a short handoff script so audio engineers can level.
- I can cover backup for slot 3 (if Priya has laptop issues).

I've added comments on the Drive doc re: cue language and a suggested mic script.

—Marissa
Producer, Events Ops
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@cloudscale.ai>, CloudScale Events <events@cloudscale.ai>, Aline Santos <aline@eventtech.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Greenscreen tech & panel rotation plan — finalizing speaker slots

Hi Priya / CloudScale Events / Aline —

Looping you in on a proposed run order for the April 7th tech-deep webinar. We're planning a greenscreen set for the live demos and short live Q&A between each segment.

What we need from you:
- Priya: confirm final talk length (we've tentatively allocated 12 minutes + 8 q/a). Also confirm whether you'll be sharing live demo slides or switching to a local app — that changes how we route video.
- Events team (Aline): can you confirm the sponsor outro timing and whether CloudScale wants a 60s recorded message or a live host handoff?

I've attached the current run order and an AV checklist the team will use for pre-show. If you can reply with confirmations by EOD Wednesday (3/24) that would keep us on schedule.

Attachments: [Attachment: run_order_v2.pdf (PDF, 220KB)], [Attachment: speaker_av_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

Best,
Ben
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Dr. Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@cloudscale.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, CloudScale Events <events@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: Aline Santos <aline@eventtech.co>
Date: 2027-03-24T08:53:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenscreen tech & panel rotation plan — finalizing speaker slots

Ben — thanks for the plan and the clear asks.

Confirmations:
- Talk length confirmed: 12 minutes + 8 minute q/a. I'll keep the demo to ~6 minutes inside my slot (short live demo of the inference dashboard + one benchmark snippet).
- I'll be sharing slides (attached) and will switch to local demo if we hit latency issues. Can Marissa schedule a 15-minute run-through on 4/5 for slides + demo flow?
- No special sponsor pre-roll needed from CloudScale; we prefer a live host handoff.

Attaching slides: [Attachment: slides_priya_v1.pptx (PPTX, 4.1MB)].

See you at the run-through — Priya
Principal ML Engineer
CloudScale (Guest Speaker)

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@cloudscale.ai>, CloudScale Events <events@cloudscale.ai>, Aline Santos <aline@eventtech.co>
Date: 2027-03-25T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final — Greenscreen rotation & AV checklist (run_order_v3)

Thanks all for the quick turn. I've baked Marissa's buffer recommendation into the schedule and updated the run order (attached run_order_v3.pdf).

Key final points:
- Final speaker order: 1) Priya (CloudScale) — live demo; 2) Redwood SME (Karthik) — deep-dive; 3) Panel discussion with CloudScale + Redwood; 4) Sponsor outro (live host handoff).
- Two-minute buffer between greenscreen handoffs (Marissa to run audio reset script).
- Tech check: 4/05 10:00–10:15 PT — mandatory for all external speakers. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=webinar
- Pre-show checklist: engineering will run through slides_priya_v1 and will have local demo fallback patched.

Attachments: [Attachment: run_order_v3.pdf (PDF, 245KB)], [Attachment: speaker_av_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 20KB)]

Please reply with a one-line sign-off. If no replies by 3/26 9:00 PT I will assume approvals and proceed to calendar invites for the tech check.

—Ben
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
